_doc: The ratchet. Every capability any game has shipped. Each new game must list every id here in its history[].capabilities, or explain in history[].not_applicable why it does not fit the genre. It must also add at least rules.min_new_firsts brand-new capabilities (added here with first_date = that game's date). Never remove entries. Enforced by scripts/check-state.py.

core-loop.description: complete playable loop with input, simulation and rendering

win-lose-states.description: clear end states the player understands, with restart

title-screen.description: title/menu screen with controls shown before play

session-best-score.description: best score or best result shown across rounds

multiple-enemy-or-piece-types.description: 4+ distinct entity/piece types with different behaviour

boss-or-climax.description: a distinct climax encounter or set piece beyond the normal loop

pickups-or-powerups.description: temporary or permanent modifiers the player acquires

screen-shake-juice.description: screen shake, flashes, knockback or similar game feel

animated-sprites.description: animated sprites (procedural or authored), not static shapes

headless-selftest.description: --selftest headless run driven by an integration test against the shipped binary

procedural-level-generation.description: levels/maps generated procedurally with validity checks

tactical-ai-opponent.description: AI that evaluates positions and actions, not just chases

persistent-save-file.description: progress or bests persisted to disk between sessions

in-run-upgrade-draft.description: pick-one-of-N upgrades that change how you play

route-choice.description: player chooses between paths/encounters in a run

multiple-biomes.description: 3+ distinct environments with their own palette and props

dynamic-lighting.description: lighting that changes with game state (visual and/or gameplay)

adaptive-music.description: music that changes with game state (intensity layers etc.)

tutorial-onboarding.description: in-game guided first-run hints plus a help screen

undo-move.description: player can take back a non-committal action

threat-preview.description: UI shows what enemies can do next (telegraphing, danger zones)

autopilot-playtest.description: a bot plays full sessions headlessly and tests assert on pacing/balance

broadcast-programming.description: player schedules from several broadcasts with distinct reach, trust and warmth effects

power-grid-allocation.description: limited operating power can be routed among station functions and relay coverage

persistent-campaign-upgrades.description: station improvements purchased between broadcasts persist through a campaign

community-trust-network.description: per-neighborhood trust and needs combine into the campaign outcome

rope-physics-traversal.description: movement built on rope/pendulum physics: hook, swing, pump, reel, release

time-rewind.description: hold-to-scrub rewind of the whole simulation with a limited resource

accessibility-assists.description: aim assist, game speed, invincible explorer mode and a pause menu to change them

time-trial-medals.description: par-time medals and persisted best times per level

third-party-art-assets.description: the look is built from vendored, credited third-party asset packs (sprites, textures, fonts, sampled sounds)

vehicle-drift-physics.description: arcade vehicle model with grip limits, per-surface handling, handbrake drift and a tiered mini-turbo

slipstream-drafting.description: driving in another vehicle's wake tows you and charges a boost resource

ghost-replay.description: best laps are recorded, persisted and raced against as a ghost

minimap.description: live map of the whole level with every competitor

championship-standings.description: points table across a multi-event championship with qualifying targets
